purpose: Context KB for pacs.008.001.08 FI To FI Customer Credit Transfer V08 validation (CBPR+ SR2026). For each XML tag: possible errors, affected tags, and fix suggestions, plus ISO 20022 / CBPR+ formal rules.

iso_20022_rules.name: RelatedPresentWhenCopyDupl
iso_20022_rules.description: If CopyDuplicate is present, Related MUST be present.

iso_20022_rules.name: InstructedAgentRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If GrpHdr/InstdAgt is present, then CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for instructed agent.

iso_20022_rules.name: InstructingAgentRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If GrpHdr/InstgAgt is present, then CdtTrfTxInf/InstgAgt is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for instructing agent.

iso_20022_rules.name: TotalInterbankSettlementAmountRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If GrpHdr/TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt is present, all CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt must use the same currency.

iso_20022_rules.name: TotalInterbankSettlementAmountAndSumRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If GrpHdr/TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt is present, it must equal the sum of all CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt.

iso_20022_rules.name: GroupHeaderInterbankSettlementDateRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is present, CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt is not allowed.

iso_20022_rules.name: TransactionInterbankSettlementDateRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is not present, CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt MUST be present.

iso_20022_rules.name: PaymentTypeInformationRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If GrpHdr/PmtTpInf is present, CdtTrfTxInf/PmtTpInf is not allowed.

iso_20022_rules.name: NumberOfTransactionsAndCreditTransfersRule
iso_20022_rules.description: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the number of CdtTrfTxInf occurrences.

iso_20022_rules.name: ChargeBearerWithChargeBearerType
iso_20022_rules.description: ChrgBr must be one of: DEBT, CRED, SHAR, SLEV. SLEV is preferred under CBPR+.

iso_20022_rules.name: AmountPositiveRule
iso_20022_rules.description: IntrBkSttlmAmt and InstdAmt must be >= 0 (minInclusive=0) with at most 5 fractional digits and 18 total digits.

iso_20022_rules.name: AgrdRatePreAgrdXchgRateRule
iso_20022_rules.description: When CdtTrfTxInf/AgrdRate (CurrencyExchange26) is present, PreAgrdXchgRate is mandatory inside it.

iso_20022_rules.name: AddtlDtTmXpryDtTmRule
iso_20022_rules.description: When CdtTrfTxInf/AddtlDtTm is present, at least one of AccptncDtTm, PoolgAdjstmntDt, or XpryDtTm must be populated.

iso_20022_rules.name: LEIFormatRule
iso_20022_rules.description: LEI fields must match pattern [A-Z0-9]{18}[0-9]{2}. Used in BranchData5/LEI and FinancialInstitutionIdentification23/LEI.

iso_20022_rules.name: IBANFormatRule
iso_20022_rules.description: IBAN must match pattern [A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,30}. Max 34 characters.

iso_20022_rules.name: BICFIFormatRule
iso_20022_rules.description: BICFI must match [A-Z0-9]{4}[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})?. 8 or 11 characters.

iso_20022_rules.name: PhoneNumberFormatRule
iso_20022_rules.description: PhoneNumber must match \+[0-9]{1,3}-[0-9()+\-]{1,30}.

iso_20022_rules.name: UUIDv4FormatRule
iso_20022_rules.description: UETR (UUIDv4Identifier) must match [a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-4[a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}.

iso_20022_rules.name: DuplicateIdentifierValue
iso_20022_rules.description: Identifiers required to be unique within a message (e.g. InstrId, TxId, EndToEndId, UETR) must not repeat across transactions or collide with GrpHdr/MsgId.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Identifier value is duplicated within the message.

iso_20022_rules.name: BicNotInDirectory
iso_20022_rules.description: Each BICFI should resolve to a registered institution in the official BIC directory.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: BIC/SWIFT code is not recognized in the official directory.

iso_20022_rules.name: MissingLeiAdvisory
iso_20022_rules.description: Under SR2026 a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is highly recommended for all financial institutions.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Agent FinInstnId is missing a recommended LEI.
